notes.title: Fix - NIT-FR-06 Boss Rush Softlock and Visual Error
notes.content:
[h2]Softlock Error[/h2][p]This update is being made to address an error where, if the player deals too much damage in one attack while fighting NIT-FR-06 (Robo frog), the game would hang after the death cutscene played from that attack. It also addresses an error where, if the attack does NOT kill, the frog would behave in a glitchy manner.  The phases should now progress as normal and not encounter problems like before.  [/p][h2]Postgame Formatting[/h2][p]This is a minor change, but I realize that as a general user flow issue, most people would receive the "You have unlocked new items in the Extras menu" notification, and then go straight there from the game finishing. This means they would skip over the boss rush prompt, and may not realize you can re-access it by restarting the game, or forget to try do so. 

I added the option to enter the boss rush to the Extras menu with the other new options instead, so that should help players be more aware of it. It also helps with the general user flow between menus by giving a way to get from the main menu to boss rush easily.

Due to this, I may later remove the opening the game prompt to access either game mode entirely, or at least confine it to only occur on the first boot.

[/p][h2]Bug Reports[/h2][p]Please submit any bugs you come across to this discussion board, and I'll fix them in a timely manner: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3218680/discussions/0/598527550147298302/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3218680/discussions/0/598527550147298302/[/url] Thank you for your patience and support![/p]

notes.title: Boss Rush Update - Release (!!) + Cirno Day Discount
notes.content:
[p][u][b]Happy Cirno Day everyone!![/b][/u][/p][p]By the time this update releases it may have already passed for some users sadly, but I hope you'll be able to enjoy it nonetheless.[/p][h1]Boss Rush[/h1][p]This content update includes several things to talk about, and acts as a mini post-game epilogue story to play once the true ending has been completed. If you have completed the final boss of the main game, all you need to do to access this content is start the game on a finished save file:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193827/bcdb786c40ee23f06584789fcefea2d5631fbe78.png"][/img][/p][p]New players will still go straight to the intro of the main game upon launch, so no major flow issues are introduced to the initial base game experience. Also, you can [u][b]now hold the Z Button to skip the logo crawl[/b][/u], regardless of having finished the game or not, so anyone who prefers the former state has the ability to skip past them at least.[/p][p][/p][h2]Content[/h2][p]While I don't want to spoil too much before you hop in and try it yourself, I will briefly outline what this update is: [/p][p]There is a [b]new mode[/b], the aforementioned boss rush, which will test the player to defeat all the threats they have faced so far with new [b]upgrades[/b] each time they play, but also one new one at the end... [/p][p]This mode will be playable both independently (without dialogue, after finishing it once.) and as a [b]small mini-story[/b] that takes place right after the conclusion of the main game, and will itself have its own ending to experience.[/p][previewyoutube="2MK3aiZSlsY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]It also contains [u][b]3 more achievements[/b][/u], one of which is for unlocking all achievements at last, so hopefully you will all enjoy getting those. I don't want to spoil too much about the direct contents, but I hope you will all enjoy it![/p][p][/p][h2]Soundtrack[/h2][p]So, after the initial unfortunate delays, the soundtrack is finally being released in parallel with this update! [/p][p]The soundtrack will be released on a discount running concurrently with the main game's discount, and will include all of the songs in the base game. In addition, the songs from the [b]Boss Rush content update[/b] will be updated into the soundtrack soon for free to anyone who owns it; past, present, or future. This will occur within a couple days of release in an extra update.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Reports[/h2][p]As always, for anyone who does encounter bugs, crashes, or unpleasant game behaviours, please submit any bugs you come across to this discussion board, and I'll fix them in a timely manner:[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3218680/discussions/0/598527550147298302/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3218680/discussions/0/598527550147298302/[/url]
Thank you for your patience and support! [/p][p]I hope you'll enjoy it! [/p][p]Sincerely, SilvaMemoria.[/p]

notes.title: Boss Rush Update ~ Teaser
notes.content:
[p]So, I have been mostly satisfied with the state of the game, and I wouldn't want to make major continuations in the form of DLC, etc. I enjoyed making this game, and it has been fun to share it with you all, some bugs aside.  [/p][p]However, I did note that many people felt it ended just a bit too soon, so I did want to add at least one small epilogue of content to the game. You can see the teaser here: [/p][previewyoutube="X_258IfZsII;full"][/previewyoutube][p] This Content Update [i]should[/i] release on a certain special day for Cirno, 09/09, exactly a year after the original trailer for the game. [/p][p]It will include:  
-The new content.  
-Some minor QoL improvements.  
-The soundtrack.  
-A new [u]Final Boss[/u] for the end of the Epilogue.

See you then![/p]

notes.title: Save File / Chapter Select Loading Problem Fix, Other Errors
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I'm hard at work at something [b]actually quite important[/b] with some [b][u]new content[/u][/b], which I'll post a teaser for soon here and on social medias (Refer to "More ways to Connect" down below or search for "Silva Memoria"), so look out for that... 

In the meantime however, and while the translation is still being written, I found some potentially major errors which I have now fixed.
[h2]Save File Error[/h2]
I don't know exactly when this was added, but at some point in time there was a data error in save files made, which made certain event cutscenes not load correctly. Luckily, no new save files will have to be made, I simply made the game patch old save files to be compatible with the new framework that lacks this data error, and it should be fine to use any older file.
If you DO have a problem loading an older save file, please let me know with the link at the bottom!

[h2]Minor Fixes[/h2]
Some other small fixes:

[list]
[*]Sometimes, burning, freezing, etc. would not trigger even on moves with a 100% chance to trigger them. This has been patched.
[*]The 3rd basic enemy (non-boss) of the game had an error when inflicting burn effects more than once, this has been fixed.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Reports[/h2]
Please submit any bugs you come across to this discussion board, and I'll fix them in a timely manner: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3218680/discussions/0/598527550147298302/

notes.title: Loading Screens, Lag, And Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Loading Screens and Battle Lag[/h2]
So, it was brought more to my attention that occasionally, some moves would "lag" the very first time they're used. I realized in testing that there was a problem with the method in which resources were loaded and cached, and I have fixed it. 

To add further on this, for the [u]first major loading screen[/u] (that is, upon starting/loading a new game, [u]not[/u] every single one between areas), there will now be a proper loading screen graphic to convey the loading progress, and that it might take slightly longer than others.

This should remove all lag during fights in the main story, and in my experience this loading screen only seems to take 1-2 seconds at most.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
This patch fixes a few small visual glitches in some battles. 
In addition, it was reported to me that the Red Frog battle may, in some very fringe cases, lead to freezing (Ironically).

Neither I nor the initial reporter could reproduce this error, but I made sure to rework the likely source just in case, so it hopefully will not occur anymore.



[h2]Bug Reports[/h2]
Please submit any bugs you come across to this discussion board:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3218680/discussions/0/598527550147298302/ 
Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Controller and Joystick Improvements, Blackscreens Fix
notes.content:
[h2]Controller and Joystick Improvements[/h2][p]Hello everyone! I was informed that the controller support I had added had a few issues in terms of joystick usage. I had mostly tested the D-Pad for precision, so I wasn't aware of some of these, and this update should patch notably:
- Overworld movement on Cirno should be significantly smoother with the joystick.
- The joystick will no longer be extremely slippery on the menus.

I was much happier with the state of the controller after this update, and found a few other general optimizations in menu control as well as for battle menus, so I hope you shall all enjoy it more in future.

(Addition - Some Battle replay blackscreens were fixed in a small post-update addendum several hours after this announcement)[/p][p] [/p][h2]Bug Reports[/h2][p]Please submit any bugs you come across to this discussion board:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3218680/discussions/0/598527550147298302/ 
Thank you for your patience.[/p]

notes.title: Native Controller Support
notes.content:
[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
Hello everyone, as of this update, I fixed a problem that was disabling controller support from functioning correctly. The game should now have partial support for most standard controller types. Currently, the only [u]FULL[/u] support is for controllers that utilize the Xbox standard layout (Wherein the A-button is at the bottom). 

Other controllers such as Sony and Nintendo models [i]should[/i] still work, but you'll have to simply use their respective [b]bottom[/b] and [b]right[/b] buttons rather than the A/B prompts provided by the in-game controller annotations.


If you have any issues with playing using a controller, please notify me here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3218680/discussions/0/598527550147298302/ 
Thank you for your patience.
